title: Shared reversible arithmetic and cleanup grammar
description: One base grammar for quantum/classical gates, arithmetic blocks, storage contracts, and measured cleanup. Executable actions require registered bindings at both widths.

definitions.Q: Peak allocated quantum wires, measured by the fixed evaluator.
definitions.T: Toffoli cost under the evaluator condition and measurement protocol.
definitions.HMR: X-basis measurement with reset, written to a fresh classical bit.
definitions.phase: The relative sign tracked by the fixed simulator on each measurement branch.
definitions.scratch: Work wires outside the input/output registers, required to end in zero.
definitions.guard: An executable premise check in the source implementation.
definitions.mapping: The same mechanism applied to the fast16 circuit and the chosen large source backend.
definitions.ABI: The ordered quantum inputs, classical addend, output registers, and clean scratch contract.
definitions.status: executable means a trusted action binding exists; specification and research describe unbound mechanisms.
definitions.measurement_protocol: An input fails when either of two measurement streams fails. Fresh full-width audits govern qualification.

rules.title: Reduce a known AND control
rules.description: The Boolean analysis proves that an AND is zero or equals one control. Replace the CCX with no gate or a CX.

mechanism.match: CCX(a,b;t) with value(a AND b) equal to 0, value(a), or value(b).
mechanism.replace: Delete a zero contribution. Otherwise XOR the proven control value into t with CX.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Remove one weighted CCX at each accepted site. Q need not change.

rules.title: Replace a phase-only AND
rules.description: A temporary AND has only Z reads before its end. Apply the equivalent phases to live operand values or their affine reconstructions.

mechanism.match: A tracked CCX contribution whose every read is Z and whose end is HMR, reset, or matching cancellation.
mechanism.replace: Remove the AND contribution. Replace Z reads with CZ of the represented operands. Repair the measured end and restore affine hosts.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Remove accepted AND contributions. Phase repair can add Clifford gates.

rules.title: Build an AND only under its read bit
rules.description: Every use of a temporary AND shares a later classical guard. Move or guard its construction and its erasure correction under that bit.

mechanism.match: A CCX whose read contexts share a copyable classical bit created before its first use.
mechanism.replace: Reconstruct operands at the legal insertion point. Construct the AND only under the read bit. Put every measured-erase phase fix under the same bit.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Change conditional Toffoli weight. The source reports expected savings before runtime evaluation.

rules.title: Erase an inverse AND by measurement
rules.description: The target contains exactly the AND that the inverse CCX would erase. Measure the target in the X basis and repair the outcome phase.

mechanism.match: An unconditional CCX(a,b;t) after which t is known to be zero.
mechanism.replace: HMR(t -> k); CZ(a,b) under k. Allocate a fresh classical outcome k.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Replace one weighted inverse CCX with HMR and a classically conditioned Clifford CZ.
notes: The additional measurement changes subsequent random-word alignment. Compare independent input outcomes, rather than aligned individual branches.

rules.title: Absorb unread writes into measured cleanup
rules.description: A wire receives only X-type writes after its last read and then reaches an unconditional reset or measurement. Move the measurement before the writes.

mechanism.match: A suffix of X, CX, and CCX writes containing all CCX writes before an unconditional R or HMR end.
mechanism.replace: Measure the content at a legal earlier point. Convert X to global sign, CX to Z, and CCX to CZ under the outcome and existing conditions. Preserve the original end outcome and reset.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Remove the accepted window CCXs. Extra measurements and conditional phase operations remain.

rules.title: Cancel adjacent involutions
rules.description: Cancel adjacent identical unitary involutions with equal complete operation records. Classical writes, measurements, resets, registers, and condition-stack operations remain barriers.

guards.description: Keep operation equality and barrier checks active.

mechanism.match: G; G with identical full Op records and G in Neg, X, Z, CX, CZ, Swap, CCX, CCZ.
mechanism.replace: Delete both operations. A stack pass also cancels pairs exposed by earlier cancellations.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Remove two gate records per accepted pair. Measure Q and T separately; Clifford cancellations can leave both unchanged.
notes: The native measurement removed588 pairs on genuine16-bit mfsur point addition. Q214 and T28051 remained unchanged. Full qualification remains separate from rewrite activation.

rules.title: Commute independent gates
rules.description: Gates on disjoint quantum and classical supports can exchange order. Context capture must remain unchanged.
preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.

Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

rules.title: Use reversible modular addition
rules.description: The block adds a signed source register into a target modulo the family field prime. It preserves the source and clears its carry scratch.

mechanism.match: u,v in the declared field representation.
mechanism.replace: u, v + s*u mod p, with s in {-1,+1}.

Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

mechanism.match: A scratch allocation whose final value is zero.

rules.title: Compose an ordered arithmetic program
rules.description: An editable block program can insert, remove, replace, or reorder up to eight typed arithmetic instructions. Full checks decide whether a new program is valid.

mechanism.replace: An ordered program over add, sub, half, double, half_u, double_u, and swap.
